author: KayPickle
body:
I was banned for apparently fly-hacking. I was glitching and it looked like I was fly-hacking. My computer crashed and it might have looked like I was fly-hacking but I promise I wasn't. May you please unban me? Thank you for taking the time to read this!

Many thanks,

TheGamingPuppy96

title: Appeal and Infraction

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

Your appeal is currently under review, you will hopefully get a reply from the Moderator who banned you soon.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello TheGamingPuppy96,

Sorry for the delayed reply, it looks like your appeal was forgotten.

Well, I spoke to the moderator that banned you and he can't find the evidence of the ban.
We want to give you the benefit of the doubt and believe you that you didn't hacked.

After looking at your infractions, I advise you to read the rules again. You can find them here: https://avicus.net/rules

Your appeal has been Accepted.

Regards Flo/resepignev :)
